en.t: Pope Formosus crowns Arnulf emperor at St Peter’s
en.s: On 22 February 896, Pope Formosus crowned Arnulf of Carinthia emperor at St Peter’s in Rome, on the site in present-day Vatican City. This entry records the coronation, not the uncertain date of his later illness.

zh.t: 教宗福尔摩苏斯在圣彼得教堂为阿努尔夫加冕
zh.s: 896年2月22日，教宗福尔摩苏斯在罗马圣彼得教堂为卡林西亚的阿努尔夫加冕为皇帝，地点位于今梵蒂冈境内。此条记录加冕仪式，不把他后来患病的日期当作已确定事实。

en.t: Girolamo Masci accepts the papacy as Nicholas IV
en.s: On 22 February 1288, Girolamo Masci accepted the papacy in Rome, in present-day Italy, taking the name Nicholas IV. He had initially been elected on February 15 but refused for a week; he was the first Franciscan pope.
en.n: This is the acceptance and pontificate start date, following the initial election on February15.

zh.t: 吉罗拉莫·马希接受教宗职位，称尼古拉四世
zh.s: 1288年2月22日，吉罗拉莫·马希在今意大利罗马接受教宗职位，称尼古拉四世。他最初在2月15日获选，但推辞了一周，后来成为首位方济各会出身的教宗。
zh.n: 此条记录接受教宗职位和任期开始的日期，最初获选是在2月15日。

en.s: The Battle of Picotin was fought on 22 February 1316 between the Catalan forces of the infante Ferdinand of Majorca, claimant to the Principality of Achaea, and the forces loyal to Princess Matilda of Hainaut, comprising native levies from the barons loyal to the Princess as well as Burgundian knights.

zh.s: 皮科廷战役于1316年2月22日爆发，交战双方是马略卡的费尔南多王子（阿该亚公国觊觎者）率领的加泰罗尼亚军队，以及效忠埃诺的玛蒂尔达公主的军队。后者包括支持公主的本地男爵征召的兵力和勃艮第骑士。

en.t: Robert II succeeds to the Scottish throne
en.s: On 22 February 1371, Robert II succeeded the childless David II as king of Scots, beginning the Stewart dynasty’s reign. His coronation was held later, on March 26.
en.n: The date follows the historical account without calendar conversion. The precise venue of this succession is unresolved.

zh.t: 罗伯特二世继承苏格兰王位
zh.s: 1371年2月22日，没有子嗣的戴维二世去世，罗伯特二世继承苏格兰王位，开启斯图亚特王朝的统治。他直到3月26日才加冕。
zh.n: 日期沿用历史资料的记载，未作历法转换。这次王位继承的具体发生地点尚未确认。

en.s: The siege of Pouancé (6 January – 22 February 1432) was undertaken by John V, Duke of Brittany, against his nephew John II, Duke of Alençon, as part of a conflict involving the payment of a dowry. It is at times referred to as the third siege of Pouancé, in succession to other sieges in 1066 and 1379.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 普昂塞围城战于1432年1月6日至2月22日进行，由布列塔尼公爵约翰五世率军围攻其侄子、阿朗松公爵约翰二世，起因是嫁妆支付纠纷。这场战役有时被称为第三次普昂塞围城战，之前两次分别发生于1066年和1379年。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 22 February 1495, the French army of Charles VIII entered Naples, in present-day Italy, without a pitched battle or siege. His coronation as king of Naples came later, on May 20.

zh.t: 查理八世的军队进入那不勒斯
zh.s: 1495年2月22日，法国国王查理八世的军队进入今意大利那不勒斯，没有经历正式会战或围城。他直到5月20日才加冕为那不勒斯国王。

en.s: The Capture of Amboina was the capture of the Portuguese fort Nossa Senhora de Anunciada in Amboina by the Dutch East India Company, under admiral Steven van der Hagen. The Portuguese governor of Ambon Gaspar de Melo surrendered the fort on 22 February 1605 to the Dutch forces, the fort was renamed to fort Victoria, and Ambon was placed under Dutch Control.

zh.s: 安汶岛陷落是荷兰东印度公司海军上将史蒂文·范德哈根率军攻占葡萄牙在安汶岛的圣母领报堡。葡萄牙安汶总督加斯帕尔·德·梅洛于1605年2月22日向荷兰军队交出要塞。要塞随后更名为维多利亚堡，安汶岛也由荷兰控制。

en.s: On 22 February 1649, royalist clans entered Inverness, Scotland, in present-day United Kingdom, expelled the castle’s garrison and subsequently demolished its defenses.
en.n: The date follows the historical British account without a calendar conversion.

zh.t: 保王派部族夺取因弗内斯城堡
zh.s: 1649年2月22日，保王派部族进入今英国苏格兰因弗内斯，驱逐城堡守军，随后拆毁城墙和防御工事。
zh.n: 日期沿用英国历史资料的记载，未作历法转换。

en.t: St. Peter's Flood: A storm surge floods the Frisian coast, drowning 15,000 people
en.s: St. Peter's flood (Dutch: Sint-Pietersvloed, German: Petriflut) refers to two separate storm tides that struck the coasts of Netherlands and Northern Germany in 1651. During the first storm tide, on 22 February, the East Frisian island of Juist was split in two. During the second disaster, on 4–5 March, the city of Amsterdam was flooded. In the past, the two storm tides were thought to have been a single event.

zh.s: 圣彼得洪水（荷兰语：Sint-Pietersvloed；德语：Petriflut）指1651年袭击荷兰和德国北部海岸的两次风暴潮。第一次风暴潮发生于2月22日，将东弗里西亚群岛的尤伊斯特岛一分为二。第二次灾害发生于3月4日至5日，阿姆斯特丹遭遇洪水。过去，人们曾误以为这两次风暴潮是同一场灾害。

en.s: The Battle of Mannar was a short battle fought between the Dutch and the opposing Portuguese forces on 22 February 1658. This battle, along with the subsequent capture of Jaffna would mark the end of Portuguese Ceylon.

zh.s: 1658年2月22日，荷兰与葡萄牙军队在马纳尔进行了一场短暂战斗。这场战役以及随后贾夫纳的陷落，标志着葡萄牙在锡兰的统治结束。

en.t: Khovansky’s forces march out of Kazan
en.s: On 22 February 1708, Khovansky marched out of Kazan with the main body of government troops during the Bashkir rebellion, in present-day Russia. The dated passage records a troop movement rather than a complete battle on that day.
en.n: The date follows the historical source without calendar conversion.

zh.t: 霍万斯基率政府军从喀山出发
zh.s: 1708年2月22日，巴什基尔起义期间，霍万斯基率政府军主力从喀山出发，地点位于今俄罗斯境内。此条记录资料明确记载的行军行动，并非声称一整场战役在当天完成。
zh.n: 日期沿用历史资料的记载，未作历法转换。

en.t: British and Franco-Spanish fleets fight off Toulon
en.s: On 22 February 1744 in the Gregorian calendar, British ships fought a Franco-Spanish fleet in the Mediterranean off Toulon. Later courts-martial and changes to naval disciplinary rules were consequences of the battle, not actions completed on that day.
en.n: February22 is the Gregorian (New Style) date, equivalent to February11 in the British Julian calendar. The fighting took place at sea.

zh.t: 英军与法国、西班牙联合舰队在土伦外海交战
zh.s: 1744年公历2月22日，英国舰队与法国、西班牙联合舰队在土伦外海的地中海交战。之后的军事审判和海军纪律规则修改是战役的后果，并非在当天全部完成。
zh.n: 2月22日采用公历新历，对应当时英国使用的儒略历2月11日。战斗发生在海上。

en.s: The Capture of Montserrat was accomplished by a French naval expedition that seized the island of Montserrat from the British on 22 February 1782 during the Anglo-French War.

zh.s: 1782年2月22日，英法战争期间，一支法国海军远征队从英国手中夺取蒙特塞拉特岛。

en.s: The Battle of Fishguard was a military invasion of Great Britain by Revolutionary France during the War of the First Coalition. The brief campaign, on 22–24 February 1797, is the most recent landing on British soil by a hostile foreign force and thus is often referred to as the "last invasion of mainland Britain". The French general Lazare Hoche had devised a three-pronged attack on Britain in support of the Society of United Irishmen.

zh.s: 菲什加德战役是第一次反法同盟战争期间，革命法国对大不列颠发动的军事入侵。1797年2月22日至24日的这次短暂行动，是外国敌对部队最近一次登陆英国本土，因此常被称为“英国本土最后一次遭入侵”。法国将领拉扎尔·奥什为支援联合爱尔兰人协会，策划了分三路进攻英国的行动。

en.s: The siege of Bharatpur took place between 2 January and 22 February 1805 in the Indian Princely state of Bharatpur (now part of Rajasthan), during the Second Anglo-Maratha War. Forces of the British East India Company, led by General Gerard Lake, were repulsed four times in their attempts to storm the fortress.

zh.s: 巴拉特普尔围城战于1805年1月2日至2月22日在印度土邦巴拉特普尔（今属拉贾斯坦邦）进行，属于第二次英马拉塔战争。由杰拉德·莱克将军率领的英国东印度公司军队四次试图攻下堡垒，均被击退。

en.s: The Battle of Pirano (also known as the Battle of Grado) on 22 February 1812 was a minor naval action of the Adriatic campaign of the Napoleonic Wars fought between a British and a French ship of the line in the vicinity of the towns of Piran and Grado in Adriatic Sea. The French Rivoli, named for Napoleon's victory 15 years earlier, had been recently completed at Venice. The French naval authorities intended her to bolster French forces in the Adriatic, following a succession of defeats in the preceding year.

zh.s: 1812年2月22日的皮拉诺海战，又称格拉多海战，是拿破仑战争亚得里亚海战事中的一次小规模海战。一艘英国战列舰与一艘法国战列舰，在亚得里亚海的皮兰和格拉多附近交战。法国“里沃利”号刚在威尼斯完工，以拿破仑15年前的一场胜利命名。法军前一年在当地接连战败，海军当局希望这艘军舰能加强法国在亚得里亚海的力量。

en.s: On February 22, 1813, British forces crossed the St Lawrence River and captured Ogdensburg, New York, United States, during the War of 1812. They later withdrew after destroying American military supplies.

zh.t: 英军攻占美国奥格登斯堡
zh.s: 1813年2月22日，1812年战争期间，英军渡过圣劳伦斯河，攻占美国纽约州奥格登斯堡。英军破坏美军物资后撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Cachirí took place on February 21–22, 1816, during the Spanish Reconquest of New Granada as part of the Colombian War of Independence. The battle is named after the Paramo de Cachirí, which is located in the Santander Department in present-day Colombia. It was fought between the Army of the North of the United Provinces of New Granada and the V Division of Spanish Expeditionary Army.

zh.s: 卡奇里战役于1816年2月21日至22日发生，是西班牙重新征服新格拉纳达行动中的一场战斗，也是哥伦比亚独立战争的一部分。战役以卡奇里高原命名，该地位于今天哥伦比亚的桑坦德省。交战双方是新格拉纳达联合省北方军和西班牙远征军第五师。

en.s: The Adams–Onís Treaty was an agreement between Spain and the United States, signed February 22, 1819, by John Quincy Adams and Luis de Onís respectively. The United States acquired Florida while renouncing claims to Spanish Texas and establishing its first transcontinental boundary. The provisions of the treaty remained in full effect only until August 24, 1821, when the Treaty of Córdoba acknowledged Mexican independence from Spain.

zh.s: 亚当斯—奥尼斯条约是西班牙和美国之间的一项协议，由约翰·昆西·亚当斯和路易斯·德·奥尼斯分别代表双方于1819年2月22日签署。美国因此获得佛罗里达，同时放弃对西属得克萨斯的主张，并确定了美国首条横贯大陆的边界。1821年8月24日，《科尔多瓦条约》承认墨西哥脱离西班牙独立后，该条约的条款不再完全有效。

en.s: The Battle of Buena Vista (February 22–23, 1847), known as the Battle of La Angostura in Mexico, and sometimes as Battle of Buena Vista/La Angostura, was a battle of the Mexican–American War. It was fought between U.S. forces, largely volunteers, under General Zachary Taylor, and the much larger Mexican Army under General Antonio López de Santa Anna.

zh.s: 布埃纳维斯塔战役于1847年2月22日至23日发生，是美墨战争中的一场战斗。在墨西哥，这场战役称为拉安戈斯图拉战役，有时也称布埃纳维斯塔／拉安戈斯图拉战役。交战双方是扎卡里·泰勒将军率领的美军（主要由志愿兵组成）和安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳将军率领、规模大得多的墨西哥军队。

en.t: Battle of Los Llanos de Santa Rosa
en.s: The Battle of Los Llanos de Santa Rosa was fought on February 22 of 1852 between the coalition of the Guatemalan and Salvadoran armies and the Honduran army under the command of José Trinidad Cabañas. In 1852, under President José Trinidad Cabañas, he led Honduran forces to Los Llanos de Santa Rosa (current day Santa Rosa de Copán to defend the tobacco factory, plantations, and tobacco production against invasions from Guatemalan and Salvadoran armies.

zh.s: 1852年2月22日，危地马拉和萨尔瓦多联军与何塞·特立尼达·卡瓦尼亚斯率领的洪都拉斯军队在圣罗莎平原交战。卡瓦尼亚斯当时担任洪都拉斯总统，并率军前往圣罗莎平原（今科潘圣罗莎），保护当地的烟草工厂、种植园和烟草生产免受危地马拉和萨尔瓦多军队入侵。

en.t: Republicans hold a national organizing convention in Pittsburgh
en.s: On February 22, 1856, Republican delegates met in Pittsburgh, United States, for a national organizing convention. This was distinct from the party’s presidential nominating convention in Philadelphia later that year.

zh.t: 共和党在匹兹堡举行全国组织会议
zh.s: 1856年2月22日，共和党代表在美国匹兹堡举行全国组织会议。这与该党当年稍后在费城举行的总统候选人提名大会是两个不同会议。

en.t: Jefferson Davis inaugurated for his six-year Confederate presidency
en.s: On February 22, 1862, Jefferson Davis was inaugurated in Richmond, Virginia, in present-day United States, for a six-year term as Confederate president. This was separate from his provisional inauguration in Montgomery on February 18, 1861.

zh.t: 杰斐逊·戴维斯举行六年任期的总统就职仪式
zh.s: 1862年2月22日，杰斐逊·戴维斯在今美国弗吉尼亚州里士满举行美利坚联盟国总统就职仪式，任期为六年。这与他在1861年2月18日于蒙哥马利举行的临时总统就职仪式是两个不同事件。

loc: 美国密西西比州奇克索县

en.s: The Battle of Okolona took place on February 22, 1864, in Chickasaw County, Mississippi, between Confederate and Union forces during the American Civil War. Confederate cavalry, commanded by Maj. Gen. Nathan Bedford Forrest, faced over 7,000 cavalry under the command of Brig. Gen. William Sooy Smith and defeated them at Okolona, causing 100 casualties for the loss of 50. Smith's force had been ordered to set off from Memphis, Tennessee, and rendezvous with the main Union army of 20,000 that was stationed at Meridian, Mississippi, and was under the command of Maj. Gen. William Tecumseh Sherman.

zh.s: 1864年2月22日，美国南北战争期间，密西西比州奇克索县发生奥科洛纳战役。内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特少将指挥邦联骑兵，在奥科洛纳击败威廉·苏伊·史密斯准将率领的7000多名联邦骑兵，以己方50人的伤亡造成敌方100人伤亡。史密斯原奉命从田纳西州孟菲斯出发，与驻扎在密西西比州默里迪恩、由威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼少将指挥的2万名联邦军主力会合。

en.s: The Second Battle of Dranesville, also known as the Ambush at Anker's Shop, was a small cavalry skirmish that took place between Confederate forces under Colonel John Mosby and Union forces under Captain James Sewall Reed east of Dranesville, Virginia in Loudoun County near present-day Sterling on February 22, 1864, as part of Mosby's operations in Northern Virginia in the American Civil War.

zh.t: 第二次德雷恩斯维尔战役
zh.s: 第二次德雷恩斯维尔战役，又称安克店铺伏击战，于1864年2月22日发生，是美国南北战争期间约翰·莫斯比在北弗吉尼亚活动的一部分。莫斯比上校率领的邦联军，与詹姆斯·休厄尔·里德上尉率领的联邦军，在弗吉尼亚州劳登县、德雷恩斯维尔以东的今斯特灵附近，发生了一场小规模骑兵交战。

en.t: Louisiana elects a governor in Union-controlled territory
en.s: On February 22, 1864, a Louisiana gubernatorial election was held under martial law in Union-controlled territory in the United States. Michael Hahn won and became civilian governor of the Union-recognized state government.

zh.t: 路易斯安那州在联邦军控制区举行州长选举
zh.s: 1864年2月22日，美国路易斯安那州在联邦军控制的地区举行州长选举，当地当时实行军事管制。迈克尔·哈恩胜出，随后成为联邦政府承认的州政府的文职州长。

en.s: The First Battle of Dalton was a series of American Civil War skirmishes that took place between February 22 and February 27, 1864, in Whitfield County, Georgia.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 道尔顿第一次战役是美国内战期间的一系列小规模冲突，于1864年2月22日至27日在佐治亚州惠特菲尔德县发生。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Daniel Coit Gilman inaugurated as Johns Hopkins University’s first president
en.s: On February 22, 1876, Daniel Coit Gilman was inaugurated as the first president of Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore, United States. The university commemorates this date as its founding anniversary.

zh.t: 丹尼尔·科伊特·吉尔曼就任约翰斯·霍普金斯大学首任校长
zh.s: 1876年2月22日，丹尼尔·科伊特·吉尔曼在美国巴尔的摩就任约翰斯·霍普金斯大学首任校长。大学将这一天作为校庆日。

en.t: Frank Woolworth opens a five-cent store in Utica
en.s: On February 22, 1879, Frank Woolworth opened a five-cent store in Utica, New York, United States. That shop failed within weeks; his subsequent Lancaster store helped develop the successful five-and-ten-cent retail chain.

zh.t: 弗兰克·伍尔沃斯在尤蒂卡开设五分钱商店
zh.s: 1879年2月22日，弗兰克·伍尔沃斯在美国纽约州尤蒂卡开设五分钱商店。这家店在数周内失败；他后来在兰开斯特开设的商店，才帮助发展出成功的五分钱和一角钱连锁零售业务。

en.s: The 1883 Victorian colonial election was held on 22 February 1883 to elect the 12th Parliament of Victoria. All 86 seats in 55 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though twelve seats were uncontested. There were 31 single-member, 20 two-member and 5 three-member electorates. The government of Sir Bryan O'Loghlen was heavily defeated at the election, with O'Loghlen himself losing his seat.

zh.s: 1883年维多利亚殖民地选举于1883年2月22日举行，以选出维多利亚第十二届议会。立法议会55个选区共选出86名议员，其中12个席位因无人竞争而直接产生。选区包括31个单议席区、20个双议席区和5个三议席区。布赖恩·奥洛克伦爵士领导的政府在选举中惨败，奥洛克伦本人也未能保住席位。

zh.s: 加拿大于1887年2月22日举行联邦大选，选出第六届国会下议院议员。原文随后开始介绍首相约翰·A.爵士所属的保守党，但在姓名写完前中断。

en.t: Cleveland signs the Enabling Act for four future states
en.s: On February 22, 1889, US President Grover Cleveland signed a bill authorizing Washington, Montana, North Dakota and South Dakota to draft constitutions and pursue statehood. Their admission as states occurred later in 1889.

zh.t: 克利夫兰签署四个未来州的建州授权法案
zh.s: 1889年2月22日，美国总统格罗弗·克利夫兰签署法案，授权华盛顿、蒙大拿、北达科他和南达科他制定宪法、推进建州。四地在当年稍后才正式成为美国的州。

en.t: Filipino forces launch a counterattack near Manila
en.s: On February 22, 1899, Filipino forces began a counterattack against American positions in the Manila and Caloocan area, in present-day Philippines. The operation continued for several days and failed to retake Manila.
en.n: This records the opening of the counterattack, not its entire duration on one day.

zh.t: 菲律宾军队在马尼拉及卡洛奥坎一带发动反攻
zh.s: 1899年2月22日，菲律宾军队在今菲律宾马尼拉及卡洛奥坎一带，对美军阵地发动反攻。行动持续了数天，未能夺回马尼拉。
zh.n: 此条记录反攻开始的日期，并非全部战斗都在一天内完成。

en.s: 1921 Iranian coup d'état, known in Iran as 3 Esfand 1299 coup d'état (Persian: کودتای ۳ اسفند ۱۲۹۹ with the Solar Persian date), refers to several major events in Qajar Iran in 1921, which eventually led to the deposition of the Qajar dynasty and the establishment of the Pahlavi dynasty as the ruling house of Iran in 1925. The events began with a coup by the Persian Cossack Brigade headed by Reza Khan on 22 February 1921.

zh.s: 1921年伊朗政变在伊朗被称为波斯太阳历1299年埃斯凡德月3日政变，指卡扎尔王朝时期发生的一系列重大事件，最终导致卡扎尔王朝被废黜、巴列维王朝于1925年建立并统治伊朗。这一系列事件始于礼萨汗率波斯哥萨克旅于1921年2月22日发动的政变。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Guatemala on 22 February 1922. The result was a victory for José María Orellana, although the military had controlled the election and silenced the opposition, as well as putting down rebellions in at least twelve places including Antigua. Orellana assumed the presidency on 4 March.

zh.s: 危地马拉于1922年2月22日举行总统选举，何塞·玛丽亚·奥雷利亚纳获胜。军方控制选举、压制反对派，并镇压安提瓜等至少12处地方的叛乱。奥雷利亚纳于3月4日就任总统。

en.s: The Battle of Sittang Bridge was part of the Burma campaign during the Second World War. Fought on 22 and 23 February 1942, the battle was a victory for the Empire of Japan, with many losses for the British Indian Army, which was forced to retreat in disarray. Brigadier Sir John George Smyth, V.C.—who commanded the British Indian Army at Sittang Bridge—called it "the Sittang disaster".
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 锡唐河桥战役是第二次世界大战缅甸战役的一部分，于1942年2月22日至23日进行。日本帝国军队获胜，英属印度军队伤亡惨重，被迫溃退。指挥英属印度军队在锡唐河桥作战的准将约翰·乔治·史密斯爵士曾称此战为“锡唐灾难”。

en.t: Roosevelt orders MacArthur to leave the Philippines for Australia
en.s: On February 22, 1942, US President Franklin D. Roosevelt decided to order Douglas MacArthur to leave the Philippines and take command of US forces in Australia. The order and its delivery were separate from his later departure.
en.n: February22 follows Washington time in the USArmy official history; personal delivery is dated the night of February22–23, not the later departure.

zh.t: 罗斯福下令麦克阿瑟离开菲律宾，前往澳大利亚
zh.s: 1942年2月22日，美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福决定下令道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟离开菲律宾，赴澳大利亚指挥美军。下令、传达命令与麦克阿瑟后来实际出发，是不同阶段。
zh.n: 2月22日采用美国陆军官方史中的华盛顿时间；当面传达命令记为2月22日至23日夜间，实际撤离则在后来。

en.s: Convoy PQ 11 (14–22 February 1942) was an Arctic convoy sent from Britain by the Western Allies to aid the Soviet Union during the Second World War. The voyage took place amidst storms, fog and the almost permanent darkness of the Arctic winter. The convoy was not found by German U-boats or reconnaissance aircraft from Norway and reached at Murmansk without loss.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: PQ 11号船队于1942年2月14日至22日航行，是第二次世界大战期间由西方盟国从英国派往苏联的北极护航船队。航行途中遭遇风暴、浓雾和北极冬季几乎持续不断的黑暗。德国潜艇和驻挪威侦察机都没有发现这支船队，它最终毫发无损地抵达摩尔曼斯克。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Yankee Clipper crashes while landing on the Tagus in Lisbon, killing 24
en.s: The Yankee Clipper (civil registration NC18603) was an American Boeing 314 Clipper flying boat, best known for on 20 May 1939 beginning the first scheduled airmail service between the United States and Europe. It crashed on 22 February 1943 while attempting to land on the River Tagus in Lisbon, Portugal, killing 24 of the 39 people on board.

zh.t: “扬基快船”号坠毁，造成24人死亡
zh.s: “扬基快船”号（民用注册编号NC18603）是一架美国波音314型水上飞机，1939年5月20日开通美国与欧洲之间首条定期航空邮件航线。1943年2月22日，该机在葡萄牙里斯本尝试降落于塔霍河时坠毁，机上39人中有24人死亡。

en.s: The Bombing of Nijmegen was an unplanned bombing attack by American aircraft on the city of Nijmegen in the Netherlands on 22 February 1944. In terms of the number of victims, it was one of the largest bombardments of a Dutch city during World War II. Officially, almost 800 people were killed, but because people that were in hiding could not be counted, the actual figure is probably higher. A large part of the historic city centre was destroyed, including Saint Steven's Church. Saint Augustine's Church and Nijmegen railway station (the intended target) were heavily damaged as well.

zh.s: 1944年2月22日，美国飞机对荷兰奈梅亨发动了一次计划外轰炸。按伤亡人数计算，这是二战期间荷兰城市遭受的最严重轰炸之一。官方死亡人数接近800，但由于躲藏避难者无法被计入，实际死亡人数可能更高。历史城区大部分被毁，包括圣斯蒂文教堂；圣奥古斯丁教堂和此次轰炸的预定目标奈梅亨火车站也严重受损。

en.s: The Battle of Ramree Island (Burmese: ရမ်းဗြဲကျွန်း တိုက်ပွဲ), also known as Operation Matador, took place from 14 January to 22 February 1945, in the Second World War as part of the offensive on the Southern Front in the Burma campaign and was conducted by the XV Indian Corps.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 兰里岛战役又称“斗牛士行动”，于1945年1月14日至2月22日进行，是第二次世界大战缅甸战役南部战线攻势的一部分，由印度第十五军执行。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 22 February 1953. They were the elections in which the Socialist Party received the most votes since 1920. However, the Austrian People's Party won the most seats. The grand coalition between the two parties was continued with Julius Raab replacing Leopold Figl as Chancellor of Austria, who had had to resign after facing criticism from his own party, and Adolf Schärf of the Socialist Party remaining Vice Chancellor.

zh.s: 奥地利于1953年2月22日举行议会选举。社会党自1920年以来首次获得最多选票，但奥地利人民党仍赢得最多议席。两党继续组成大联合政府。利奥波德·费格尔因受到本党批评被迫辞去总理，由尤利乌斯·拉布接任；社会党的阿道夫·谢尔夫继续担任副总理。

en.t: Ngô Đình Diệm survives a shooting at Buôn Ma Thuột
en.s: On 22 February 1957, South Vietnamese president Ngô Đình Diệm survived an assassination attempt at an agricultural fair in Buôn Ma Thuột, in present-day Vietnam. The gunman missed Diệm and wounded a minister before being overpowered.

zh.t: 吴廷琰在邦美蜀遭枪击未遂
zh.s: 1957年2月22日，南越总统吴廷琰在邦美蜀参加农业展会时遭遇刺杀未遂，地点位于今越南境内。枪手未击中吴廷琰，却打伤一名部长，随后被制服。

en.s: The 1962 attempted coup in Turkey (also known as the February 22 Incident) was led by the Commander of the Turkish Military Academy, Staff Colonel Talat Aydemir and his associates, who were opposed to the democratically elected government in Turkey. Despite taking control of much of Ankara, the coup leaders quickly realised they could not prevail and surrendered without any loss of life occurring.

zh.s: 1962年土耳其未遂政变又称“2月22日事件”，由土耳其军事学院院长、上校塔拉特·艾德米尔及其同伴领导。他们反对土耳其民选政府。政变领导人虽一度控制安卡拉大部分地区，但很快意识到无法取胜，随后投降，没有造成人员死亡。

en.s: The Aldershot bombing was an attack by the Official Irish Republican Army (Official IRA) using a car bomb on 22 February 1972 in Aldershot, England. The bomb targeted the headquarters of the British Army's 16th Parachute Brigade and was claimed as a revenge attack for Bloody Sunday. Seven civilian staff were killed and nineteen wounded. It was the Official IRA's largest attack in Britain during "the Troubles" and one of its last major actions before it declared a ceasefire in May 1972.

zh.s: 1972年2月22日，爱尔兰共和军正统派在英格兰奥尔德肖特发动汽车炸弹袭击，目标是英国陆军第16伞兵旅总部。该组织称这是对“血腥星期日”的报复。袭击造成7名文职人员死亡、19人受伤。这是北爱尔兰冲突期间，该组织在英国发动的最大规模袭击，也是它于1972年5月宣布停火前最后几次重大行动之一。

en.s: The 1972 Qatari coup d'état was a bloodless palace coup that took place in Qatar on 22 February 1972. The coup was carried out by the heir apparent and prime minister Khalifa bin Hamad Al Thani, who took control of the country while his cousin, Emir Ahmad bin Ali Al Thani, was on a visit to Iran.

zh.s: 1972年2月22日，卡塔尔发生一场没有流血的宫廷政变。王储兼首相哈利法·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼，趁堂兄埃米尔艾哈迈德·本·阿里·阿勒萨尼访问伊朗时，夺取国家控制权。

en.t: 1972 Republic of the Congo coup attempt
en.s: On February 22, 1972 a radical-left faction of the ruling PCT attempted a coup against Congolese president Marien Ngouabi. The coup was led by Ange Diawara, along with other Politburo members including Claude-Ernest Ndalla and Jean-Baptiste Ikoko. Joachim Yhombi-Opango was instrumental in ending the coup. The musician Franklin Boukaka was killed in the coup, as was former Minister Élie Théophile Itsihou.

zh.s: 1972年2月22日，执政的刚果劳动党内一个激进左翼派系试图推翻总统马里安·恩古瓦比。政变由安热·迪亚瓦拉领导，克洛德-欧内斯特·恩达拉和让-巴蒂斯特·伊科科等政治局成员也参与其中。约阿希姆·洪比-奥潘戈在平息政变中发挥了关键作用。音乐家富兰克林·布卡卡和前部长埃利·泰奥菲尔·伊西图胡也在政变中遇害。

en.t: Samuel Byck attempts to hijack an aircraft at Baltimore/Washington International Airport with the intention of crashing it into the White House to assassinate Richard Nixon, but commits suicide after being wounded by police
en.s: Samuel Joseph Byck (January 30, 1930 – February 22, 1974) was an American hijacker and attempted assassin. On February 22, 1974, he attempted to hijack a plane flying out of Baltimore/Washington International Airport, intending to crash into the White House in the hopes of killing U.S. President Richard Nixon. Byck killed an airport policeman and the plane's copilot and wounded the pilot, but Byck was shot and wounded by another policeman before committing suicide.

zh.t: 塞缪尔·比克劫持飞机未遂
zh.s: 塞缪尔·约瑟夫·比克（1930年1月30日—1974年2月22日）是美国劫机者和刺杀未遂者。1974年2月22日，他试图在巴尔的摩／华盛顿国际机场劫持一架飞机，打算撞向白宫刺杀美国总统理查德·尼克松。他杀死一名机场警员和飞机副驾驶，并打伤机长；随后另一名警员开枪将比克打伤，比克最终自杀。

en.t: Second Islamic Summit opens in Lahore
en.s: On February 22, 1974, the Second Islamic Summit opened in Lahore, Pakistan. The meeting of heads of state and government ran until February 24.

zh.t: 第二届伊斯兰首脑会议在拉合尔开幕
zh.s: 1974年2月22日，第二届伊斯兰首脑会议在巴基斯坦拉合尔开幕，各国元首和政府首脑参加会议。会议持续到2月24日。

en.s: The 1976 Progressive Conservative leadership election was held at the Ottawa Civic Centre in Ottawa on February 22, 1976, to elect a leader of the Progressive Conservative Party of Canada to replace Robert Stanfield, who had resigned after losing the 1968, 1972, and 1974 elections. It unexpectedly elected a 36-year-old, little-known PC Member of Parliament from Alberta as the party's new leader. Joe Clark defeated Claude Wagner on the fourth ballot of the convention by a margin of 65 votes. The convention's delegates were elected by the party's riding associations, along with the party's youth, campus and women's associations.

zh.t: 1976年加拿大进步保守党党魁选举
zh.s: 1976年2月22日，加拿大进步保守党在渥太华市政中心选举新党魁，接替在1968、1972和1974年大选中接连失利后辞职的罗伯特·斯坦菲尔德。年仅36岁、当时鲜为人知的艾伯塔省国会议员乔·克拉克意外当选。他在大会第四轮投票中，以65票优势击败克洛德·瓦格纳。大会代表由该党各选区组织，以及青年、校园和妇女组织选出。

en.s: The 1977 United States House of Representatives special election in Minnesota's 7th congressional district was held on February 22, 1977, to select the successor to Bob Bergland (DFL) who resigned to accept appointment as Secretary of Agriculture under the Carter Administration. Independent-Republican candidate Arlan Stangeland defeated the DFL favorite, Mike Sullivan, in an upset landslide.

zh.t: 1977年明尼苏达州第七国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 1977年2月22日，美国明尼苏达州第七国会选区举行联邦众议员特别选举，填补民主农民劳工党议员鲍勃·伯格兰的空缺。他辞职接受卡特政府任命，出任农业部长。独立共和党候选人阿兰·斯坦格兰爆冷，以压倒性优势击败原本被看好的民主农民劳工党候选人迈克·沙利文。

en.s: On 22 February 1979, Saint Lucia became independent from the United Kingdom. It remained a Commonwealth realm with the British monarch as head of state.

zh.t: 圣卢西亚脱离英国独立
zh.s: 1979年2月22日，圣卢西亚脱离英国独立。独立后仍为英联邦王国，以英国君主为国家元首。

en.t: Miracle on Ice: In Lake Placid, New York, the United States hockey team defeats the Soviet Union hockey team 4–3
en.s: The "Miracle on Ice" was an ice hockey game during the 1980 Winter Olympics in Lake Placid, New York. It was played between the hosting United States and the Soviet Union on February 22, 1980, during the medal round of the men's ice hockey tournament. Although the Soviet Union was a four-time defending gold medalist and heavily favored, the United States achieved an upset victory, winning 4–3.

zh.t: 冰上奇迹：美国冰球队以4比3击败苏联队
zh.s: “冰上奇迹”是1980年冬季奥运会期间在纽约州普莱西德湖举行的一场冰球比赛。比赛于1980年2月22日进行，由东道主美国队对阵苏联队。苏联队此前连续四届夺得奥运金牌，是赛前热门，但美国队以4比3爆冷获胜。

en.t: The notorious Broadway flop Moose Murders opens and closes on the same night at the Eugene O'Neill Theatre
en.s: Moose Murders is a play by Arthur Bicknell, self-described as a mystery farce. A notorious flop, it is now widely considered the standard of awfulness against which all Broadway failures are judged, and its name has become synonymous with those distinctively bad Broadway plays that open and close on the same night. It had its single performance (excluding its 13 previews) at the Eugene O'Neill Theatre on February 22, 1983.

zh.t: 百老汇剧目《驼鹿谋杀案》当晚开演又停演
zh.s: 《驼鹿谋杀案》是阿瑟·比克内尔创作的一部自称为“神秘闹剧”的戏剧。这部剧因表现糟糕而臭名昭著，如今常被视为衡量百老汇失败剧目的典型，其名称也成了那类开演当晚便停演的糟糕百老汇剧目的代称。除13场预演外，该剧于1983年2月22日在尤金·奥尼尔剧院正式演出一场，此后便停演。

en.s: General elections were held in Western Samoa on 22 February 1985. Voting was restricted to matai and citizens of European origin ("individual voters"), with the matai electing 45 MPs and Europeans two. The result was a victory for the Human Rights Protection Party, which won 31 seats. Its leader, Tofilau Eti Alesana, remained Prime Minister.

zh.s: 西萨摩亚于1985年2月22日举行大选。只有马泰，也就是家族首领，以及被称为“个人选民”的欧洲裔公民有投票权；马泰选出45名议员，欧洲裔选民选出2名。人权保护党赢得31席，取得胜利，党魁托菲劳·埃蒂·阿莱萨纳继续担任总理。

en.t: February 1986 Reform the Armed Forces Movement coup
en.s: The February 1986 Reform the Armed Forces Movement coup was a failed coup d’état in the Philippines set in motion by the Reform the Armed Forces Movement (RAM) under the leadership of Defense Minister Juan Ponce Enrile. The coup was meant to depose then-President Ferdinand Marcos, but was discovered and aborted in its earliest stages on February 22, 1986.

zh.t: 1986年2月菲律宾改革武装部队运动政变
zh.s: 1986年2月，菲律宾“改革武装部队运动”在国防部长胡安·庞塞·恩里莱领导下策划政变，企图推翻时任总统费迪南德·马科斯。但行动在2月22日刚开始时就被发现并中止，政变未遂。

en.t: Reconnaissance and artillery fire reported in the Chumik sector
en.s: On 22 February 1989, Indian helicopters conducted reconnaissance in the Chumik sector and a post was then shelled, according to the retained account. Pakistani forces sent their own reconnaissance mission. This was an early phase of the wider Chumik confrontation.
en.n: The Chumik sector lies in the disputed Siachen region. The exact post’s location is unresolved and is not assigned to a country solely from a belligerent’s nationality.

zh.t: 丘米克地区出现侦察飞行与炮击
zh.s: 据所引资料记载，1989年2月22日，印度直升机在丘米克地区进行侦察，随后一处哨所遭炮击。巴基斯坦部队也派出侦察任务。这是更大范围丘米克对峙的早期阶段。
zh.n: 丘米克地区位于存在争议的锡亚琴一带。具体哨所位置尚未核实，不依据交战方国籍将其直接归入某个国家。

en.t: 1989 Major Indoor Soccer League All-Star Game
en.s: The 1989 Major Indoor Soccer League All-Star Game was the 10th playing of the league's mid-season game featuring the all-stars of the original Major Indoor Soccer League (MISL). The game was held on February 22, 1989, at Reunion Arena in Dallas, Texas, the home of the Dallas Sidekicks. Dallas had been chosen by the league to host the game in February 1987, beating out competing bids by Baltimore and San Diego.

zh.t: 1989年美国室内足球联赛全明星赛
zh.s: 1989年美国室内足球联赛全明星赛是该联赛的第十届赛季中期全明星赛，由原美国室内足球联赛（MISL）的全明星球员参加。比赛于1989年2月22日在得克萨斯州达拉斯的团圆体育馆举行，该馆是达拉斯边锋队的主场。联盟于1987年2月选择达拉斯承办比赛，击败了巴尔的摩和圣迭戈的申办。

en.s: General elections were held in Malta on 22 February 1992. The Nationalist Party remained the largest party, winning 34 of the 65 seats. The Labour party performed very poorly in the 1992 election, losing by nearly 13,000 votes. Mifsud Bonnici resigned due to deteriorating health and on the 26 March Labour elected Alfred Sant as the new leader.

zh.s: 马耳他于1992年2月22日举行大选。国民党在65个议席中赢得34席，继续保持第一大党地位。工党表现很差，以近13000票之差落败。米夫苏德·邦尼奇因健康恶化辞去党魁职务，工党于3月26日选出阿尔弗雷德·桑特接任。

en.s: The 1996 Newfoundland general election was held on February 22, 1996, to elect members of the 43rd General Assembly of Newfoundland. It was won by the Liberal Party under new leader Brian Tobin. PC Leader Lynn Verge was not re-elected in her riding of Humber East.

zh.s: 1996年2月22日，纽芬兰举行大选，选出纽芬兰第四十三届议会成员。由新任党魁布赖恩·托宾领导的自由党获胜。进步保守党党魁琳恩·维奇未能在汉伯东选区连任。

en.s: SuperBrawl VIII was the eighth SuperBrawl professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on February 22, 1998, from the Cow Palace in San Francisco, California. Eleven matches were contested at the event, including one dark match. The main event saw Sting defeat Hollywood Hogan to win the vacant WCW World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: “超级争霸赛VIII”是世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）举办的第八届“超级争霸赛”职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1998年2月22日在加利福尼亚州旧金山的牛宫体育馆举行。赛事共11场比赛，其中一场不向付费转播观众播出。主赛中，斯汀击败“好莱坞”霍根，夺得当时空缺的WCW世界重量级冠军。

Francis Ford Coppola's The Rainmaker was selected as the closing night film. The Golden Bear was awarded to Central Station directed by Walter Salles. en.s: On 22 February 2000, the stated polling period for the Bihar Legislative Assembly election in India ended. Voting took place between February 12 and 22, so the entry records the last day rather than a single-day election.

zh.s: 2000年2月22日，印度比哈尔邦议会选举的投票时段结束。资料所载投票时段为2月12日至22日，此条记录最后一天，并非指整场选举只在一天内完成。

en.t: Manipur holds the second polling day of its assembly election
en.s: On 22 February 2000, Manipur, India, held the second polling day of its assembly election. The two listed polling dates were February 12 and 22.

zh.s: 2000年2月22日，印度曼尼普尔邦议会选举举行第二天投票。资料列出的两天投票日期分别为2月12日和22日。

en.t: Jonas Savimbi killed in fighting with Angolan government forces
en.s: On 22 February 2002, UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi was killed in a clash with Angolan government forces in Angola. His death was followed by renewed moves toward ending the civil war.

zh.t: 安哥拉反对派领导人若纳斯·萨文比在交战中身亡
zh.s: 2002年2月22日，安盟领导人若纳斯·萨文比在安哥拉与政府军交战时身亡。此后，结束内战的进程重新推进。

en.t: Pride FC: The Best, Vol.1 held in Tokyo
en.s: On February 22, 2002, Pride FC: The Best, Vol. 1, a mixed martial arts event, took place at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.t: PRIDE“The Best”系列首场赛事在东京举行
zh.s: 2002年2月22日，PRIDE“The Best”系列首场综合格斗赛在日本东京后乐园大厅举行。

en.s: The 2004 CAF Super Cup was the 12th CAF Super Cup, an annual football match organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), between the winners of the previous season's CAF Champions League and CAF Confederation Cup competitions. The match was contested by 2003 CAF Champions League winners, Enyimba, and 2003 African Cup Winners' Cup winners, ES Sahel, at the Aba Stadium in Aba, Nigeria, on 22 February 2004.

zh.s: 2004年非洲超级杯是第12届该项赛事，由非洲足球联合会每年举办。原文概述称参赛者为上赛季非洲冠军联赛和非洲联盟杯冠军，而本届具体为2003年非洲冠军联赛冠军恩因巴，对阵2003年非洲优胜者杯冠军沙希尔星。比赛于2004年2月22日在尼日利亚阿巴的阿巴体育场举行。

en.s: A moment magnitude (Mw) 6.4 earthquake struck northern Kerman province, Iran on 22 February 2005, at 05:55:22 Iran Standard Time (02:25:22 UTC). At least 612 people were killed and 5,000 more were injured, with most of the fatalities occurring in several rural villages near the epicenter. Thousands of homes were damaged or destroyed, most of them in Zarand County, the earthquake's epicentral location.

zh.s: 2005年2月22日伊朗标准时间5时55分22秒（UTC 2时25分22秒），伊朗克尔曼省北部发生矩震级6.4级地震。至少612人死亡，另有5000人受伤；大多数遇难者来自震中附近的几个乡村。数千所房屋受损或被毁，其中大部分位于震中所在的扎兰德县。

en.s: (This article is about the 2006 bombing. For the 2007 bombing, see 2007 al-Askari Mosque bombing.) The 2006 al-Askari mosque bombing occurred at the al-Askari mosque in the Iraqi city of Samarra, on February 22, 2006, at about 6:44 a.m. local time (0344 UTC). The attack on the mosque, one of the holiest sites in Shia Islam, is not claimed by any group; U.S. President George W. Bush suggested that "the evidence indicates" that it was "an Al Qaida plot". The mosque was severely damaged, but no injuries occurred in the blasts.

zh.s: 2006年2月22日，当地时间早晨约6时44分，即协调世界时3时44分，伊拉克萨迈拉的阿斯卡里清真寺遭到炸弹袭击。这座清真寺是什叶派伊斯兰教最神圣的地点之一。没有组织宣称负责，美国总统乔治·W.布什则表示，“证据表明”袭击是基地组织策划的。爆炸严重损坏清真寺，但没有造成人员受伤。此案与2007年同一清真寺遭袭事件不同。

en.t: Philippine military reports questioning officers over an alleged coup plot
en.s: On February 22, 2006, the Philippine military reported questioning at least 14 officials over an alleged plot against President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo. Some had been allowed to return to their assignments. This was before the state of emergency declared on February 24.
en.n: This is the contemporary report date. The allegation was not a conviction, and questioning is not equated with arrest.

zh.t: 菲律宾军方称已就涉嫌政变计划询问军方人员
zh.s: 2006年2月22日，菲律宾军方称，已就涉嫌推翻阿罗约政府的计划询问至少14名军方人员，其中一些人获准返回原岗位。这早于2月24日宣布全国紧急状态，并不代表所有人都已被逮捕或定罪。
zh.n: 此条采用当时报导的日期。涉事指控不等于已被定罪，接受询问也不直接等同于被逮捕。

en.s: The city of Chicago, Illinois held a nonpartisan mayoral election on Tuesday, February 22, 2011. Incumbent Mayor Richard M. Daley, a member of the Democratic Party who had been in office since 1989, did not seek a seventh term as mayor. Candidates needed to collect 12,500 petition signatures by November 22, 2010 to qualify for a place on the ballot. April 5, 2011 was scheduled to be a runoff election date if no candidate received an absolute majority. Rahm Emanuel won the race for mayor with more than 55% of the vote. He was inaugurated on May 16, 2011.

zh.s: 美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥于2011年2月22日星期二举行不以党派名义参选的市长选举。自1989年执政的民主党市长理查德·M.戴利不再争取第七个任期。候选人须在2010年11月22日前收集12500个请愿签名，才能列入选票。若无人获得绝对多数，原定于2011年4月5日进行第二轮。拉姆·伊曼纽尔最终以超过55%的选票胜出，并于5月16日就职。

en.s: A major earthquake occurred in Christchurch on Tuesday 22 February 2011 at 12:51 p.m. local time (23:51 UTC, 21 February). The Mw 6.2 (ML 6.3) earthquake struck the Canterbury Region in the South Island, centred 6.7 kilometres (4.2 mi) south-east of the central business district. It caused widespread damage across Christchurch and killed 185 people, making it New Zealand's fifth-deadliest disaster.

zh.s: 2011年2月22日星期二当地时间中午12时51分（UTC 2月21日23时51分），克赖斯特彻奇发生强烈地震。地震矩震级为6.2级（本地震级6.3级），震中位于南岛坎特伯雷地区，距克赖斯特彻奇中央商务区东南6.7公里（4.2英里）。地震在克赖斯特彻奇造成大范围破坏，185人遇难，是新西兰死亡人数第五多的灾害。

en.s: The 2011 Kansas City mayoral election was held February 22 and March 22, 2011 to elect the mayor of Kansas City, Missouri. It saw the election of Sly James, who unseated incumbent mayor Mark Funkhouser (who was eliminated in the primary).

en.t: Four hostages killed aboard the yacht Quest
en.s: On 22 February 2011, four American hostages were killed aboard the yacht Quest in the Indian Ocean during a confrontation between Somali pirates and US Navy forces. The yacht had been seized off Oman earlier in the month.

zh.t: “探索”号游艇上的四名美国人质遇害
zh.s: 2011年2月22日，索马里海盗与美国海军在印度洋对峙期间，“探索”号游艇上的四名美国人质遇害。游艇此前在阿曼外海被劫持。

en.s: The 2012 Buenos Aires rail disaster, also known as the Once Tragedy, occurred on 22 February 2012, when a train crashed at Once Station (Spanish: Estación Once de Septiembre; IPA: [ˈonse]) in the Balvanera neighbourhood of Buenos Aires, Argentina. There were about 1,000 passengers on board when the crowded eight-carriage train, whose working brakes were not activated, hit the buffers at the end of the line, crushing the motor carriage and the following two carriages, after approaching the station at a speed of 26 kilometres per hour (16 miles per hour).

zh.t: 2012年布宜诺斯艾利斯列车事故
zh.s: 2012年2月22日，阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯巴尔瓦内拉区的九月十一日车站发生列车事故，也称“九月十一日车站惨剧”。一列拥挤的八节编组列车载着约1000名乘客，以每小时26公里、约16英里的速度进站。列车制动器本可正常工作，却未被启动，列车撞上轨道尽头的缓冲挡，导致动力车厢及后面的两节车厢被挤毁。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Djibouti on 22 February 2013. After their boycott of the 2008 elections, opposition groups contested the elections as the Union for National Safety alliance. According to government figures, the ruling Union for the Presidential Majority won 43 of 65 seats in Parliament. However, the opposition claimed the figures for Djibouti city were falsified and released alternative results which would have reduced the UMP to 40 seats and increased their total from 21 to 25.

zh.s: 吉布提于2013年2月22日举行议会选举。曾抵制2008年选举的反对派这次组成“全国救国联盟”参选。按政府公布的数据，执政的总统多数派联盟在65个议席中赢得43席。但反对派指称吉布提市的结果遭到篡改，并公布另一组结果：按其数据，执政联盟应为40席，反对派则由21席增至25席。

en.s: The 2013 Saudi Crown Prince Cup final was the 38th final of the Crown Prince Cup. It took place on 22 February 2013 at the King Fahd International Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and was contested between Al-Hilal and Al-Nassr. It was Al-Hilal's 13th Crown Prince Cup final and Al-Nassr's fifth final. This was the first meeting between these two clubs in the final.

zh.s: 2013年沙特王储杯决赛是第38届王储杯决赛，于2月22日在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的法赫德国王国际体育场举行，由利雅得新月对阵利雅得胜利。这是新月第13次、胜利第五次进入王储杯决赛，也是两队首次在决赛相遇。

en.s: The Fourth Battle of Gao was fought in the city of Gao on 20–22 February 2013, during the Northern Mali Conflict. It was an attempt by rebel MOJWA forces to retake the city. The attempt was repelled by Malian government forces with the support of troops from France and Niger.

en.t: Ukraine’s parliament declares Yanukovych no longer performing his duties
en.s: On February 22, 2014, Ukraine’s parliament in Kyiv adopted a resolution declaring that Viktor Yanukovych had withdrawn from performing his constitutional duties and set an early presidential election for May 25. This was a specific parliamentary action during the Euromaidan crisis.
en.n: The entry records adoption of Resolution757-VII. It does not describe the vote as a completed constitutional impeachment trial or claim all protests ended that day.

zh.t: 乌克兰议会认定亚努科维奇不再履职，并决定提前选举
zh.s: 2014年2月22日，乌克兰议会在基辅通过决议，认定维克托·亚努科维奇已自行停止履行总统宪法职责，并决定于5月25日提前举行总统选举。这是欧洲广场危机中的一项具体议会行动。
zh.n: 此条记录第757-VII号决议的通过，不将其写成已完成宪法弹劾程序，也不声称所有抗议活动都在当天结束。

en.s: The 2014 Japanese Super Cup was held on 22 February 2014 between the 2013 J. League champions Sanfrecce Hiroshima and the 2013 Emperor's Cup winners Yokohama F. Marinos. Sanfrecce Hiroshima won the match 2–0 after a Gakuto Notsuda and Takuma Asano goal.

zh.s: 2014年日本超级杯于2014年2月22日举行，由2013年J联赛冠军广岛三箭对阵2013年天皇杯冠军横滨水手。广岛三箭凭借野津田岳人和浅野拓磨的进球，以2比0获胜。

en.s: Fastlane (2015) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE. It took place on February 22, 2015, at the FedExForum in Memphis, Tennessee. It was the first Fastlane event, replacing Elimination Chamber. Seven matches were contested on the main card with no match on the pre-show. In the main event, Roman Reigns defeated Daniel Bryan to retain his WWE World Heavyweight Championship shot against Brock Lesnar at WrestleMania 31. Also at the event Triple H had a "face-to-face" confrontation with Sting. The event received 46,000 buys (excluding WWE Network views), down from the Elimination Chamber 2014 figure of 183,000 buys, which predated the launch of the WWE Network.

zh.s: “快车道2015”是WWE举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2015年2月22日在田纳西州孟菲斯的联邦快递论坛球馆举行。这是首届“快车道”，取代原定的铁笼密室淘汰赛。正式节目共七场比赛，赛前节目没有比赛。主赛中，罗曼·雷恩斯击败丹尼尔·布赖恩，保住在第31届摔角狂热大赛挑战布洛克·莱斯纳、争夺WWE世界重量级冠军的资格。Triple H也在赛事中与斯汀面对面对峙。赛事付费购买次数为4.6万，不含WWE Network观看量；2014年铁笼密室淘汰赛的18.3万次购买发生在WWE Network推出之前。

en.s: On 22 February 2015, a two-deck ferry traveling on the Padma River in the Manikganj District, Dhaka Division in Dhaka, Bangladesh, capsized. Up to 70 people, including 19 children, were killed in the crash when it hit a trawler.

en.t: 2018 United States embassy attack in Podgorica
en.s: On 22 February 2018, a Serbian-born man threw an explosive grenade inside the embassy of the United States in Podgorica, the capital of Montenegro. He then blew himself up outside the compound with another explosive. The attack occurred around midnight when the embassy was closed, and nobody was wounded. Russian authorities denied any involvement.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Togo on 22 February 2020. Incumbent president Faure Gnassingbé of the Union for the Republic (UPR) was re-elected for his fourth term with 71% of the vote in the first round.
